name: Dashboard Plus
author: Muhammad Ijaz Anjum

sections.description:
🌟 Make WordPress look like your platform—brand the login & dashboard.

🌟 DashboardPlus – Transform Your WordPress Login & Dashboard Experience ✨== 🚀

  1. DashboardPlus gives you full control over your WordPress Login Page and Admin Dashboard, allowing you to create a professional, branded, and user-friendly experience — without writing a single line of code.
  2. Make your WordPress backend look like your brand, not WordPress.

🎨 Login Page Customization ✨== 🚀

✅ Add your own logo
✅ Change background image / gradient / color
✅ Customize login form width, radius, shadow & spacing
✅ Change button styles, hover effects & fonts
✅ Show or hide WordPress branding
✅ Live preview changes in real time (Customizer-based)

Your login page becomes a professional entry point to your website.

🧭 Dashboard Customization ✨== 🚀

Take control of the WordPress admin dashboard:

✅ Rebrand the admin area with your logo & color theme
✅ Create custom dashboard welcome widgets
✅ Hide unnecessary menus for specific user roles
✅ Remove WordPress nag screens, footer credits, updates message
✅ Replace the default “Welcome to WordPress” screen
✅ Organize dashboard for clients, teams & members

Give your users a clean and guided environment they’ll appreciate.

🏢 Perfect For ✨== 🚀

  1. Agencies managing client sites

  2. Branding-conscious businesses

  3. Membership platforms

  4. LMS / E-learning dashboards

  5. Multi-user teams

  6. Freelancers delivering premium websites

  7. Make WordPress feel professional, polished, and uniquely yours.

🚀 Upgrade Your Brand — From First Login to Daily Workflow ✨== 🚀

  1. Your WordPress experience shouldn’t look generic.

  2. With DashboardPlus, your website’s identity is seen and felt everywhere.

💡 Why DashboardPlus? ✨== 🚀

✨ Features 🚀 Description
1. Live Customizer Controls 🚀 Edit and preview in real time — no refresh needed.
2. Custom Background 🚀 Upload images, set solid colors, gradients, or patterns.
3. Logo Controls 🚀 Change, resize, hide, or fully replace the default login logo.
4. Button Styling 🚀 Adjust size, color, radius, border, and hover states.
5. Form Design Options 🚀 Control padding, width, background, shadow, and radius.
6. Typography Settings 🚀 Change text size, labels, links, and tagline.
7. One-click default restore 🚀 Reset everything back to WordPress default anytime.
8. Version text 🚀 Customize version text
9. Footer text 🚀 Customize footer text
sections.installation:
=Automatic installation=
1. Automatic installation is the easiest option .
2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu, and click “Add New.”
3. In the search field type “Dashboard Plus ” then click “Search Plugins.”
4. Find “Dashboard Plus ” and install it by! Click “Install Now,”
=Manual installation=
1. Download the dashboardplus.zip file to your computer.
2. Unzip the file.
3. Upload the plugin to your ‘wp-content/plugins’ directory, or install automatically via your admin panel.
4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
